summary.en: Syria has confirmed deploying troops to Saudi Arabia to fight the Houthis, while publicly denying any Syrian presence in Yemen. Syrian security forces killed a former aide to an Assad-era military commander in a clash in western Syria. The Syrian government and Jordan have signed cooperation deals as they seek to mend ties after deadly airstrikes. The conflict caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Syria har bekreftet at de har sendt tropper til Saudi-Arabia for å kjempe mot houthiene, samtidig som de offentlig benekter enhver syrisk tilstedeværelse i Jemen. Syriske sikkerhetsstyrker drepte en tidligere assistent til en militær kommandør fra Assad-æraen i en sammenstøt i vestlige Syria. Den syriske regjeringen og Jordan har signert samarbeidsavtaler mens de søker å reparere forholdet etter dødelige luftangrep. Konflikten forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
